No. S. B. D. 2859.
Date 7/11/
Late 8 - 11 - 31/931.

Subject (in full) Attempted Communist Demonstration on Robinson Road.

Made by D.S.I. A. Turner. Forwarded by Inspector i/c. （签名）

Sir,
Between 6 and 8 p.m. today about 300 to 400 Chinese gathered on
Robinson Road in the vicinity of the Kamamura Memorial Tower and
also at the Lung Hwa Li Alleyway. An attempt was made to demonstrate
by firing crackers and shouting Anti-Kuomintang slogans, this was
frustrated by the arrival of a party of Police under Inspector Hilt.
Some Communistic and Anti-Kuomintang pamphlets were picked up by
the Police, these are being forwarded with this report. Detectives
moving among the crowd ascertained that several students present
were from the Kyloh Dah Middle School, Narknan Road. The crowd were
kept on the move by the Police who finally withdrew at about 8:30
p.m. without further incident. No arrests were made.

（批：Daily Report of 9/11/31）

（签名）
A. Turner,
D. S. I.

（批：H.P. 8.11.31. Note Arrest of Lecturer etc at Tarchow
and Hospital Road. Charge with
"Rebellious Propaganda". File SBD 2880）

主题（全称） 罗宾森路未遂的共产党示威活动。

由特别调查员 A. Turner 制作。由负责督察转发。（签名）

先生：
今日下午6时至8时之间，约300至400名华人聚集在
罗宾森路（Robinson Road）川村纪念塔附近及
龙华里弄堂。有人试图通过燃放鞭炮和呼喊反国民党口号进行
示威，但因 Hilt 督察率领的一队警员赶到而受阻。
警方捡获一些共产主义及反国民党传单，现随本报告一并呈送。
混入人群的侦探查明，在场的几名学生来自南京路的格致中学（Kyloh Dah Middle School）。警方迫使人群不断移动，最终于晚上8:30左右撤离，期间未发生其他事件。无人被捕。

（批注：1931年11月9日日报）

（签名）
A. Turner，
特别调查员。

（批注：H.P. 1931年11月8日。注：在大兆路（Tarchow）
和医院路逮捕讲师等人。指控
“叛逆宣传”。档案 SBD 2880）

Subject (in full) 14-th Anniversary of the Soviet Rule.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by （签名）

In connection with the 14-th anniversary of Soviet
Rule in Russia which falls on November 7-th,enquiries show that
the local White Russian organizations do not propose to mark
the day by any activities other than the holding of church ser-
vices at about 7.30 p.m.,after the usual evening services, in com-
memoration. of all victims of the Bolshevist revolution . It is
possible that members of the White Russian community will be re-
quested to hoist Russian national flags at half-mast and draped
with black ribbons,at their residences.

There are no indications,so far,of any arrangements
on the part of local Soviet citizens to celebrate the anniversary,
but inquiries will be continued and any information of interest
will be immediately reported.

Attached is a list of Russian churches in Shanghai
and also a list of Soviet establishments.

G. Prokofiev
D. S.

主题（全称） 苏维埃政权十四周年纪念日。

由特别探员 Prokofiev 制作 由 （签名）转发

鉴于俄罗斯苏维埃政权十四周年纪念日将于11月7日到来，调查显示，当地白俄组织不计划举行除教堂礼拜以外的任何活动来纪念这一天；即在晚间常规礼拜结束后，于晚上7:30左右举行教堂仪式，以纪念布尔什维克革命的所有受害者。白俄社区成员可能会被要求在其住所降半旗悬挂俄国国旗，并系上黑丝带。

目前尚无迹象表明当地苏联公民有任何庆祝该纪念日的安排，但调查将继续进行，任何有价值的信息将立即上报。

附件为上海俄国教堂名单以及苏联机构名单。

G. Prokofiev
特别探员

特别处负责人。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. 2859 File No.
6/11/31 Section 2, Status
REPORT
Date November 6, 1931
ect (in full): The 14th Anniversary of the Soviet Revolution, November 7:
possible demonstrations by local communists.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by O.S.D. Burnett.

Communistical handbills bearing on the 14th
anniversary of the Soviet Revolution, which falls on November 7,
calling for demonstrations have occasionally made their
appearance in the Settlement, but no venue has been suggested.
A general strike has also been advocated by the local communist
fraternity, but most probably this will not materialize.
Information from other sources indicate that
local communists may attempt to hold demonstrations and
disseminate communistic handbills at the following places
on the morning or during the evening of November 7:-
1) Pingliang and Thorburn Roads (Yangtszepoo District).
2) Pootoo and Zongmin Road corner (Between 8.30 and 10 a.m.)
3) Robison Road, between Ying Hwa Li (葆華里) and
Kawamura Memorial Tower. (Between 6 and 8 p.m.)

（批：Included in Daily Report of Nov. 6. 1931. R.B. S.R.）

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告
日期 1931年11月6日
主题（全称）：11月7日苏维埃革命十四周年纪念日：
当地共产党人可能举行的示威活动。
由侦探 Kuh Pao-hwa 制作 由 O.S.D. Burnett 转发。

涉及11月7日苏维埃革命十四周年纪念日的共产主义
传单，呼吁举行示威活动，偶尔在租界内出现，但未提出具体地点。
当地共产党团体也鼓动总罢工，但这很可能不会实现。
来自其他来源的情报表明，
当地共产党人可能试图在11月7日上午或晚间
在以下地点举行示威并散发共产主义传单：-
1) 平凉路和韬朋路（杨树浦区）。
2) 普陀路与宗民路交叉口（上午8:30至10:00之间）
3) 罗宾森路，介于英华里（葆華里）和
川村纪念塔之间。（下午6:00至8:00之间）

（批注：收录于1931年11月6日日报。 R.B. S.R.）

Kuh Pao-hwa
侦探

特别处负责人。

Subject (in full) rumoured demonstrations by communists on November 7.

Made by Supt Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by Amy Robertson, c.p.i.

Information has been received from Mr Wong the Nanking
political agent that communists will demonstrate on November 7
in the following districts.
1. French Concession.
Rue de Marche
Rue Amiral Bayle
2. Eastern district
Yangtzepoo Road
Thorburn Road
Ping Liang Road
3. Western district
Ferry Road
Robison Road
in the vicinity of the Memorial Tower

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c S.B.

S2,
Any information on this
subject please ?
J.A.
D.I. Kirk. 30:10:'31.
For attention. S.B.R.
Enquiries proceeding.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. G. REGISTRY
No. S. D. 2857
Date 2. 11. 31.

November 2nd, 1.

CONFIDENTIAL

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No.86 of October 30, regarding the activities of
communists on November 7, 1931 and to inform you
that the matter is receiving attention.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Assistant Commissioner (Sp.Br.),
for Commissioner of Police.

Colonel Chen Hsi Tseng,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Greater Shanghai Municipality.

Supt. Tan,
Please keep in touch with
Ch. Authorities, with a view to
securing any information re possible
happenings on Nov. 7 which they
obtain.
Report forwarded.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY D. 2857 Date 8. 11. 31.）

Translation of Letter from Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

No. 政 96.                                          October 30, 1931.

Captain Horton,
Commissioner of Police,
S. M. P.

Sir,

    I am in receipt of a confidential report to
the effect that communist activities will take place
at the following places on November 7:-

International Settlement.
    Eastern District - Yangtzepoo, Wardum & Pingliang Rds.
    Western District - Perry & Robison Roads near the
                       Big Clock (Japanese Confront)

French Concession.
    Southern District - Rue du Marche, Rue Amiral Bayle
                        and Chel Tung Road (Arsenal Road)

    I shall be glad to convey the above information
to you so that precautionary measures can be arranged.

                                            Chen Hsi Tsang,
                                            Chief of Public Safety Bureau,
                                            Shanghai.

for M

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & S. B. 登记室 D. 2857 日期 1931年11月8日。）

上海公安局来信译文。

编号 政 96。                                          1931年10月30日。

Horton 上尉，
警务处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

先生：

    本人收到一份机密报告，
称共产党活动将于11月7日在
以下地点进行：-

公共租界。
    东区 - 杨树浦路、华德路和平凉路。
    西区 - 裴伦路和罗宾森路，靠近
                       大钟（日本对面）

法租界。
    南区 - 马尔斯路（Rue du Marche）、贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）
                        和斜土路（Arsenal Road）

    本人乐意将上述信息
转达给贵方，以便安排预防措施。

                                            Chen Hsi Tsang,
                                            上海公安局局长，
                                            上海。
